reviews.comment: The guy cares, but I could not follow his lectures. He mainly read off of slides, and he could not control the room. Everyone would leave twenty minutes early, so he would just stop teaching altogether. I asked a question, and he did not give a clear response. The class is easy if you took Chem AP in high school, but I was left to my own devices.

He is a decent professor, very willing to help outside of class, and doesn't grade harshly.
Pay attention in lectures.
Everything is graded online, including midterms and finals.
care about your quiz grades (6 quizzes) ,they can bring your grade down if you don't focus on them.
You will have to put effort in this class if you don't know chemistry.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The professor teaches the necessary objectives, but you do have to do some self learning with the homework. The class overall was not too difficult, especially if you took AP Chemistry from what I have heard.

Be ready to pay close attention to every lecture. On the older side so his teaching style is also old which made it hard to get used to his lectures at the beginning, but after you get used to it (if you actually pay attention in class) you'll fly through this class. The homework assignments are very helpful so make sure you spend time on them.

Dr. Hall is a very nice guy. His lectures are clear, iClicker is used to grade participation and keep engagement, but you can get a perfect iClicker score without going to every class. Do the online OWL homework, it's very helpful. Quizzes are bi-weekly and are difficult, but he posts high quality study material the day before the quiz.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework
